statement: Pinned Dolphin's Classic Controller emulator exposes a 16-byte extension calibration block at register 0xA40020: left and right joystick X/Y max/min/center triplets (12 bytes), neutral values for two analog triggers (2 bytes), and two trailing checksum bytes. These are source-model structures, not authenticated factory values.

applicability.revision: Emulator or Linux/SDL host source behavior; retail revision not measured
applicability.scope: Extension.h 70-91; Classic.cpp 142-175; Classic Pro physical layout not assumed identical.
